Charlemagne’s mid-19th-century Nevsky and Gostiny Dvor lithograph and Durand’s 1839 Nevsky view inform broad storefront rhythm, avenue scale and perspective only. They do not verify exact 1848 paving, storefronts, materials, or map coordinates; the project-authored pixel map remains a broad visual interpretation.
